title: TSBPO: Tree-Structured Branching for Policy Optimization in Interactive Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41697v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training interactive language agents from terminal outcomes poses three coupled problems: which task and state continuations to sample, how to assign delayed feedback to decisions, and how to aggregate token losses for multi-token actions. We present TSBPO, a tree-structured sampling-to-update paradigm that addresses these problems within one training loop. A likelihood-fitted Root/Branch allocator uses retained task and state evidence to target continuations likely to produce contrasting terminal outcomes under fixed rollout budgets. On the resulting replayed physical trees, trajectory advantages compare immediate sibling segments, while observation-group step advantages compare outcomes at matched task/observation states. The actor then sums clipped token surrogates over each complete response and normalizes across active turns, avoiding response-length averaging in the policy-gradient term. translated_title: TSBPO：面向交互式语言智能体策略优化的树结构分支方法
translated_abstract: 从终端结果训练交互式语言智能体面临三个相互耦合的问题：应采样哪些任务与状态延续、如何将延迟反馈分配到各个决策上，以及如何为多词元动作聚合词元损失。我们提出TSBPO，一种树结构的“采样到更新”范式，在单一训练循环内解决上述问题。一个基于似然拟合的根/分支分配器利用保留的任务与状态证据，在固定rollout预算下将延续采样定向到可能产生对比性终端结果的分支上。在由此构建的重放物理树中，轨迹优势通过比较直接相邻的兄弟片段来计算，而观察组步骤优势则在匹配的任务/观察状态下比较不同结果。随后，执行器对每个完整响应求和裁剪的词元代理项，并在活跃轮次间进行归一化，从而避免了策略梯度项中的响应长度平均。使用Qwen2.5-1.5B作为执行器，固定检查点……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: TSBPO提出一种树结构的采样到更新范式，通过似然拟合的根/分支分配器定向采样、基于兄弟片段与匹配观察状态的延迟反馈分配、以及跨活跃轮次归一化的词元损失聚合，在单一训练循环中解决了从终端结果训练交互式语言智能体的三大耦合难题。
en_tdlr: TSBPO introduces a tree-structured sampling-to-update paradigm that resolves three coupled problems in training interactive language agents from terminal outcomes—continuation sampling, delayed feedback assignment, and multi-token loss aggregation—via a likelihood-fitted Root/Branch allocator, sibling-segment trajectory advantages, and cross-turn normalized token surrogates within a single training loop.
